title: Queue profile definition
description: See spec/04-data-schemas.md 'Phase 0/1 content fields' and spec/08-interfaces-core.md §8.11 (QueueProfileDefinition). ServiceRatePerServerPerMinute: spec/09-interfaces-flow.md §9.4. CapacityStanding: §9.5. ThresholdWaitMinutes/HysteresisMinutes: spec/10-events.md §10.6, §10.3 rule 4.
